header: Priced per practice and per practitioner
subheader: Talbrunn runs appointments, billing and recall letters for physiotherapy, occupational therapy and speech therapy practices.
lead: Every plan has the same software and differs only in practitioners and addresses. There is no activation fee, no minimum term and no charge per patient.
note: All prices exclude 20% Austrian VAT. We invoice monthly in arrears, and you can cancel at the end of any month.
